healthcare.note: Canada provides universal public healthcare (covered provincially) with no standard monthly consumer cost for residents. Newcomers may need private travel/supplemental insurance during a province's waiting period (commonly 0-3 months) — cost varies too much by provider and province to show a single sourced figure here.

healthcare.note: Monthly equivalent of the UK's Immigration Health Surcharge (£1,035/year for most adult visa holders). In reality this is paid as one upfront lump sum for your full visa duration, not billed monthly — shown here as a monthly equivalent purely for comparison against the other categories.
